REAL-TIME INTERACTION

A score that

stays open.

The proposal considers TouchDesigner’s music

panel and sensor input as possible connections

between performance and imagery. Scene

switching also gives the operator a way to

follow changes in musical atmosphere.

PERFORMANCE PRINCIPLE

Keep the musician present.

Visual intensity should leave room for the physical

performer. Light, transparency and image timing are

composed together.
